# Session: recipes

`cinnabar:session/recipes@0.1.0`

The recipes the server sent that the client decodes, as the vanilla recipe book and the
station screens use them. Every function errs only when the `recipes` permission is denied.

**Grants:** `recipes`.

Imported type `item-key`: [`item-key`](session-items.md#type-item-key).

Imported type `stack`: [`stack`](session-items.md#type-stack).

## Types

<a id="type-ingredient-kind"></a>

### `ingredient-kind`

An exact item, an identifier accepting any aux value, or an item tag.

```wit
variant ingredient-kind {
    item(item-key),
    any-aux(string),
    tag(string),
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `item` | `item-key` |  |
| `any-aux` | `string` | Any aux value of this identifier (aux 32767 on the wire). |
| `tag` | `string` | Any member of this item tag. |

Types: [`item-key`](session-items.md#type-item-key).

<a id="type-ingredient"></a>

### `ingredient`

One required ingredient and its stack count; empty shaped cells are represented outside this record.

```wit
record ingredient {
    kind: ingredient-kind,
    count: u8,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `ingredient-kind` |  |
| `count` | `u8` |  |

Types: [`ingredient-kind`](session-recipes.md#type-ingredient-kind).

<a id="type-category"></a>

### `category`

The recipe station or transformation family, preserving its distinct ingredient ordering.

```wit
enum category {
    crafting,
    stonecutter,
    cartography,
    smithing-transform,
    smithing-trim,
    furnace,
    blast-furnace,
    smoker,
    brewing,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crafting` |  |  |
| `stonecutter` |  |  |
| `cartography` |  |  |
| `smithing-transform` |  |  |
| `smithing-trim` |  |  |
| `furnace` |  |  |
| `blast-furnace` |  |  |
| `smoker` |  |  |
| `brewing` |  | The brewing stand: the input potion, then the reagent. Brewing has no network id (0). |

<a id="type-recipe"></a>

### `recipe`

One decoded recipe with station-specific input order and resolved output stacks.

```wit
record recipe {
    network-id: u32,
    category: category,
    shapeless: bool,
    width: u8,
    height: u8,
    ingredients: list<option<ingredient>>,
    outputs: list<stack>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `network-id` | `u32` |  |
| `category` | `category` |  |
| `shapeless` | `bool` |  |
| `width` | `u8` | A shaped crafting recipe's size; zero otherwise. |
| `height` | `u8` |  |
| `ingredients` | `list<option<ingredient>>` | Shaped: `width * height` cells, row-major, `none` for an empty cell. Otherwise the<br>inputs in order: stonecutter and furnaces the input; cartography the map, then the modifier;<br>smithing the template, the base, then the addition. |
| `outputs` | `list<stack>` | Empty for a smithing trim, which decorates its base. |

Types: [`category`](session-recipes.md#type-category), [`ingredient`](session-recipes.md#type-ingredient), [`stack`](session-items.md#type-stack).
